label: Three BitSafe Decentralization Manager nodes, one per Canton participant, connected as peers
Talang's valuation committee: one decentralized party, hosted on all three participants. 2 of 3 must confirm
A pricer on node 1 proposes a markdown: UST10Y to 92,000. The MarkProposal is a BitSafe GovernableAction
Node 1 confirms. 1 of 2: not enough, nothing is published
Node 2, in its own DecMan, sees the same proposal and confirms
Back on node 1: Execute. BitSafe's GovernanceRules publishes the mark as the committee
Node 3 did not vote. Its audit trail shows every step on-chain: propose, two confirmations, execute
Talang: the lender calls margin on an open repo with the committee's mark. No single pricer could move it
